title: Before you scale content, fix the foundations.
description: Map commercial intent, check indexability and make measurement useful.
author: Montshire Media editorial team

sections.heading: Audit the pages buyers need
sections.text: Review crawling, indexation, canonical signals and internal links before increasing publishing volume.

sections.heading: Connect intent to a useful next step
sections.text: Group searches by the decision a buyer is making. Give each priority page a clear purpose.

sections.heading: Measure business contribution
sections.text: Track qualified enquiries alongside organic visibility. Annotate changes and compare like-for-like periods.

title: A better brief for your next Google Ads campaign.
description: Start with the customer, the economics and the conversion you can trust.
author: Montshire Media editorial team

sections.heading: Define a qualified conversion
sections.text: Agree with sales on the lead criteria that matter before choosing campaign targets.

sections.heading: Match message to intent
sections.text: Separate exploratory searches from high-intent evaluation. Align the ad, landing page and offer.

sections.heading: Build a learning budget
sections.text: Set a test hypothesis, a review window and a decision rule before increasing investment.

title: Web performance is a product decision.
description: Treat speed as part of the buying experience, from the first request onward.
author: Montshire Media editorial team

sections.heading: Start with the critical journey
sections.text: Identify the landing pages and interactions that determine whether a visitor can take the next step.

sections.heading: Set a performance budget
sections.text: Control image weight, third-party scripts and font delivery. Test on a representative mobile device.

sections.heading: Measure real experience
sections.text: Use field data when available. Review LCP, INP and CLS alongside accessibility and conversion behaviour.
